working_definition: Olfactory projection neuron type DL1 (Xie et al. 2021) at 0 h or 24 h APF.
searches_performed: immature antennal lobe projection neuron DL1

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any antennal lobe projection neuron (FBbt:00007422) that develops from some neuroblast BAmv3 (FBbt:00067346).

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator), but FBbt has no immature (or remodelling) antennal lobe projection neuron terms yet (requested, curator 2026-10-17); meanwhile the stage-neutral class for the authors' lineage (adPN), to be refined when the new terms exist. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: adPN 69, lPN 2.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067349 antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (broad match) until FBbt has the immature / remodelling term for DL1.
